## Summary

```text
Merged PR
├── Preview with ghcr.io/lhajoosten/release-log:latest and a read-only App token
└── Recompute and verify in a separate SHA-pinned writer with its own App token
```

The writer reads the GitHub event, source history and shared checked-in configuration independently. It receives no preview outputs or artifacts. Writes run by default when the App is configured. Set the Actions configuration variable `RELEASE_LOG_WRITE_ENABLED` to `false` to keep previews and disable writes.

The writer uses Release Log v0.5.2 and retains v0.5.1 for replay of existing generated proposals. The App configuration enables the job by default. `RELEASE_LOG_WRITE_ENABLED=false` replaces the previous enable flag.

## Evidence

- `actionlint` passed.
- Checked both jobs share the same captured release configuration, the Docker step has a read-only token and `--dry-run`, and the writer gets only trusted inputs.
- The website’s `pnpm check` passed.
- Live post-merge writes with the installed App were outside local verification.

## Merge Danger

**Door** Two-way. Set `RELEASE_LOG_WRITE_ENABLED=false` to pause the writer, or revert the workflow change.

**Blast radius** Release proposal maintenance, exact-landing tags, and GitHub Releases where configured.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Separate read-only Release Log previews from release writes.
impact: Release previews follow the latest stable CLI while a pinned writer applies verified release changes.
required_action: null
```

## Summary

```text
pull_request / main push / manual run
  Source complexity → pinned Lint Gate → report-only TypeScript findings
```

The pull request scan uses the policy from the base commit. It starts on normal PRs after the first policy lands on main. The workflow needs Contents read and persists no checkout credentials.

This caller keeps the repository-specific report-only policy and triggers. Review it after [Lint Gate #18](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lint-gate/pull/18) lands.

## Evidence

- The [hosted push rehearsal](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/actions/runs/44957057067) ran and passed the shared analyzer. The [hosted PR rehearsal](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/actions/runs/44957064031) verified policy bootstrap.

- The initial hosted run reproduced four Tree-sitter diagnostics at literal ampersands in valid JSX text. The TypeScript-only run passed. [Initial run](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/actions/runs/44946811264) · [Corrected run](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/actions/runs/44946979625)
- The exact Action pin scanned eight TypeScript files locally with zero analysis errors. A local PR simulation used the report-only base policy despite a changed candidate policy.
- Workflow lint and the existing `pnpm check` completed successfully.

## Merge Danger

Two-way. Disable Source complexity in GitHub Actions to pause it. The blast radius is the advisory complexity report.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Add an advisory TypeScript complexity report.
impact: Maintainers can review Lint Gate findings in a standalone GitHub Actions workflow.
required_action: null
```

## Summary

```text
150-line site workflow → 47-line caller with the same site release config
  → pinned provider preview and writer
```

Depends on [Rolling Release #164](https://github.com/lhajoosten/rolling-release/pull/164). The provider owns runtime and replay maintenance. The site owns its release policy, App setup, and write switch.

## Evidence

- The site configuration JSON, App secret reference, and repository token permissions match the old caller.
- `actionlint` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Before activation, review the provider revision and pause merge writes with `RELEASE_LOG_WRITE_ENABLED=false`. Verify the hosted manual and merged-PR previews and the old producer replay before enabling the new writer.

## Merge Danger

Reversible through the prior reviewed caller. Merging follows the site's production approval flow.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Pilot a simpler release workflow for the portfolio.
impact: Maintainers upgrade one workflow pin while keeping the same site release policy.
required_action: null
```
